replacements.Huella real vs declarada: energía, CO₂ y: Real vs declared footprint: AI electricity, CO₂ and waste
replacements.Los compromisos de neutralidad climática: Big-tech carbon-neutrality commitments are not equivalent to real-time renewable consumption. Annual PPA accounting hides actual hour-by-hour emissions.
replacements.La carga de IA crece mucho más rápido qu: AI workloads are growing much faster than total data-center demand. Greenpeace (2025) places that multiplier over seven years, not a full decade.
replacements.Las emisiones reales superan entre 1,6 y: Actual emissions are between 1.6 and 7.6 times the declared figures because PPAs are accounted for annually, not hour by hour.
replacements.Por encima de la capacidad actual de rec: Above the current capacity of specialized recycling systems. Producing a leading-edge semiconductor wafer requires ~2.3 MWh. Greenpeace (2025).
replacements.Por qué los compromisos renovables no eq: Why renewable commitments are not equivalent to renewable consumption
replacements.Los contratos de compra de energía renov: Renewable power purchase agreements (PPAs) signed by Google, Microsoft and Amazon guarantee that an equivalent amount of renewable energy enters the grid each year. They do not guarantee that the electricity reaching the data center at every moment is renewable. Emissions are offset on paper but not avoided in real time. Microsoft announced in 2023 an agreement to restart part of Three Mile Island's nuclear generation as a direct response to this timing problem.
replacements.Fuente: Greenpeace (2025). Datos de emis: Source: Greenpeace (2025). CO₂-emissions range based on regional electricity mix and data-center efficiency. Annual PPAs do not solve hourly decarbonization.
